description:
Analysis extent for Flood, Chad, 20 August 2024 (FL20240820TCD): 76 features merged from 66 source layers. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Satellite detected water extent in Bongor City as of 26 August 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extent-in-bongor-city-as-of-26-august-2024)
- [Satellite detected water extent in Koukou Angarana City, Sila Region, Chad as of 3 September 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extent-in-koukou-angarana-city-sila-region-chad-as-of-3-september-2024)
- [Satellite detected water extent in N'Djamena City as of 08 October 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extent-in-n-djamena-city-as-of-08-october-2024)
- [Satellite detected water extent in N'Djamena City as of 26 August 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extent-in-n-djamena-city-as-of-26-august-2024)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 02 and 06 October 2024 over Chad](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-02-and-06-october-2024-over-chad)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 13 and 17 October 2024 over Chad](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-13-and-17-october-2024-over-chad)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 15 and 19 August 2024 over Chad](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-15-and-19-august-2024-over-chad)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 20 and 24 August 2024 over Chad](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-20-and-24-august-2024-over-chad)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 31 August and 04 September 2024 over Chad](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-31-august-and-04-september-2024-over-chad)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated. The decoded text is in `ConfidenceID_label`.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = WorldView-1; 2 = WorldView-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = WorldView-3; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT-4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 39 = RESOURCESAT-1; 40 = Landsat-8; 41 = SPOT-6; 42 = Sentinel-1; 43 = Kompsat-2; 44 = Sentinel-2; 45 = Sentinel-3; 46 = Kompsat-3; 47 = Deimos-2; 48 = TripleSat; 49 = PlanetLabs; 50 = RapidEye; 51 = WorldView-4; 52 = SPOT-7; 53 = Jilin-1; 54 = GaoFen-2; 55 = SkySat; 56 = ICEYE; 57 = Landsat-9; 58 = VIIRS-NOAA; 59 = RCM-1; 60 = RCM-2; 61 = RCM-3; 62 = TanDEM-X; 63 = BlackSky; …. The decoded text is in `SensorID_label`.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `FieldValidation_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 2 source files of this collection use 2 different domains for it, so read `StaffID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Shape_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Shape_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID_label
table:columns.description: `ConfidenceID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation_label
table:columns.description: `FieldValidation` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: Site_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = UN Building; 1 = Mosque; 2 = Hospital; 3 = Refugee / IDP Camp Building; 4 = Market; 5 = School / University; 6 = Square; 7 = Government Building; 9 = Border Crossing Point; 12 = Cemetery; 13 = Ruins; 16 = Stadium; 19 = Sewage Treatment Facility; 21 = Greenhouse; 22 = Bridge; 23 = Road; 24 = Tower; 25 = Prison; 26 = Building (General / Default); 27 = Field; 28 = Industrial Facility; 30 = Refugee / IDP Camp Site; 35 = Transport Vehicle; 40 = Military Base; 41 = Checkpoint; 42 = Military Facility; 45 = Suspected Mass Grave Site; 46 = Airport Facility; 47 = Church; 48 = Dam; 49 = Port; 50 = Power station; 51 = Power tower; 52 = Railway; 53 = Commercial; 54 = Tourism. The decoded text is in `Site_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Site_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Site_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
